name: folio
title: Folio
description: The document layer's pieces that travel with a document: Markdown with directives (scene, diagram, price-table, timeline, signature, note), rendered to HTML by a pure parser with line-numbered errors; the print sheet and the script that makes scenes print their still; the seal (the policy, the hash and verify) and the in-page check that lets a reader hash their own copy. The builder that inlines, subsets, seals and prints (build/, bin/) is a Node dev tool with npm dependencies (esbuild, subset-font, Playwright), so it stays in the repo and is not copied.

budget.reason: Decision 0010 in spirit: the Markdown parser and directive renderer (md/index.js 22.9 KB, which checks a diagram's lines with folio-diagram's grammar,, md/parse.js 14.7 KB) are a pure core that runs in Node at build time and is fully tested; they never ship inside a sealed document. What a document carries is folio-print.js and folio-check.js, 1.9 KB together, and build/seal.mjs (3.6 KB) runs only in Node for folio verify. Declared at 44 KB: today 42.4 KB.
